kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نرتقب (form VIII)
# نَرْتَقِبُ (nartaqibu) /nar.ta.qi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# نُرْتَقَبُ (nurtaqabu) /nur.ta.qa.bu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# نَرْتَقِبَ (nartaqiba) /nar.ta.qi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# نُرْتَقَبَ (nurtaqaba) /nur.ta.qa.ba/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
